headline: Cheonggyak Selection Heats Up as Apartment Prices Rise: Top 10 Builders Draw Concentrated Subscriptions
summary: Subscription results this year show a sharp gap between top-10 builders and mid-sized and small builders. Smaller builders offered over 10,000 more general-supply units, yet first-priority accounts concentrated on top-10 complexes.
why: Housing supply and builder demand are key drivers of South Korea's property market, which affects construction firms, lenders and household spending.
